The two copied targets keep their historical source links under the original leaves. A grouped commit may list a sibling path in file_impact; Scope ownership and the present-path inventory count each path once. This epic makes no repository edits.

## Plan
- Complete every remaining leaf against its owned present Scope: recorded structural and focused checks, an independent per-block semantic/bloat review receipt, Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with 0 unresolved comments, merged commit, and standalone completion verification. Historical leaves may document a deliberately delegated CI gate rather than claim an uncited local full run.
- Close each workstream only after all its children close and its log records separate historical-source and current-execution inventories, dispositions for moved/deleted/copied paths, and review/gate evidence.
- Combine the 6 story migration TSVs by immutable source ID and historical path. Preserve all 1,499 retired source rows, including those with no current path. Schema: source_id, source_alias, historical_source_path, story_alias, historical_replacement_leaf, disposition, verified_current_path_or_blank, current_action_leaf_or_blank, evidence.
- Combine the 6 story execution TSVs by present path at final origin/main. Count each of the 1,449 present paths once with one Scope owner; record source-free additions and copied targets. Schema: current_path, story_alias, execution_leaf_alias, source_count, retired_source_alias_or_blank, copy_source_alias_or_blank, scope_evidence, pinned_main.
- Store both combined TSVs, their SHA-256 values, the final main SHA, and all 6 story-log IDs in a linked epic session_log. The working drafts at e539e4a have broader crosswalk columns; transform and verify them against the final merged main before closing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] All 6 workstream stories and all 119 remediation leaves are closed.
- [x] The migration inventory has exactly 1,499 distinct retired source IDs and historical paths, each with 1 net-active replacement leaf, a disposition, and evidence; the 65 sources with no current path remain counted.

- [x] Moved and copied targets retain source identity; grouped-commit file_impact overlap does not inflate either inventory.
- [x] Edited prose has independent per-block before/final review evidence for semantic preservation and bloat removal. Deleted historical files have explicit dispositions rather than invented current review rows.
- [x] Each leaf trail records its applicable verification outcome (local pass or explicit CI delegation), Gerrit Change-Id, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments, MERGED status, and exact merged SHA reachable from final main.
- [x] The epic log records both final inventories and all 6 story-log IDs. The epic completion comment cites the log, counts, SHA-256 values, and final main SHA.

## Completion boundary
